title: 第19章 各有精彩第20章 家族任务
content_zh:
所有人都被即将开展的好戏所吸引，没有人看到落寞离去的利伟·埃利斯，嘴角上扬，带着计谋得逞的笑容。
‘斗吧！大浪淘沙，真金不怕火炼，现在表演的舞台已经搭好，就看你们能都有什么精彩的表现，殿下的未来丈夫，一定是最优秀的。’
想到这，利伟·埃利斯目光一转，看向了一旁正眯着眼睛看戏的默里·格林，被人盯着的默里·格林心神一动，按照感觉转头迎向了利伟·埃利斯。
发现利伟·埃利斯正盯着自己，默里·格林有些疑惑，不过却面带微笑的点了点头，继续看起了热闹。
‘这家伙的精神力绝对是我们这群人中最强的，才一周不到，就表现的如此突出了，真是天才啊！不知道能不能成为战法，要是能成为战法的话，也有几分希望。’
利伟·埃利斯抬头看向了宴会乐队的指挥者，右手伸出食指，转动两圈，然后猛的往上一拉，原本平缓的宴会音乐立即高昂起来，乐队指挥者双手用力挥舞，音乐变得越发激昂。
激昂的舞曲传入耳中，正在对峙的两波人越发亢奋，海登·马杰里与身边几人对视一眼，一马当先的往前走去，对面的外地同学也不甘示弱，三个人同时往前一踏，都想做第一人。
“哈哈哈，一群游兵散将，也想来北地染指我们的伊丽莎白殿下，癞蛤蟆想吃天鹅肉，痴心妄想。”
被嘲讽的外地同学脸色一变，但踏出第一步的三名同学都没有一人选择后退，而是收敛神色，继续往前。
“在下海登·马杰里，添为马杰里侯爵之子，想认识一下各位。”
海登·马杰里右手抬起一杯葡萄酒，脸色一正，打响了战争第一枪。
“马伦·里德，南地里德公爵之孙。”
“班奈特·利顿，王都利顿公爵之子。”
“古斯塔夫·皮尔斯，王都皮尔斯公爵之子。”
难怪这三人互不相让，原来身份地位都差不多，谁要是让了，退缩了，就是对自己的贵族姓氏抹黑。
“哼！这群功勋贵族也来凑热闹。”
就在这时，一个不知道哪传来的声音响起，听到这句话，来自王都的班奈特·利顿和古斯塔夫·皮尔斯脸色微变，不过却还是和海登·马杰里碰杯，一口喝下杯中的葡萄酒。
整个兰耶斯王国可以分成五个部分，东西南北中，国王坐镇中部王都，是王国支柱，东西南北四大公爵镇守王国四周，是大名鼎鼎的边境守护。
在北地，所有贵族是国王册封，都属于国王的附庸，只是贵族等级上有所差距，侯爵与公爵只在贵族等级上差了一级，但实际上却有着巨大的差距。
北地大公不仅能收取自己领地上的税收，甚至能和国王一起分享整个北地的税收，并且在战时，北地大公自动拥有整个北地的兵马控制权、征兵权和战争指挥权。

所以东西南北四大公爵，除了在税收和对外宣战权这两项权利上有所限制，其他的与一个公国统治者没多大区别。
四大公爵的地位仅次于国王陛下，是整个兰耶斯王国唯四的封地公爵，而除了封地贵族，兰耶斯王国还存在功勋贵族，这些功勋贵族没有领地，只有年金，而且贵族爵位不能世袭。
在封地贵族眼里，这些功勋贵族都是国王陛下养的高级打手，只要实力够强，就能被封为贵族。
因此封地男爵都看不起功勋公爵。
而现在，这些功勋贵族的子嗣居然想凭借伊丽莎白殿下，一跃成为北地大公的丈夫，染指北地大公的权力，在他们头顶上作威作福，这可让周围的北地贵族子嗣异常愤怒。
当海登·马杰里喝完退下之时，下一个人又举着酒杯，顶了上去，北地的同学排着队，想给对面点颜色看看。
“无聊，又是喝酒，嗯！开始放舞曲了，我得去陪约好的美女跳舞了。”
人与人的悲伤并不相通，所以这些北地同学的愤怒，默里·格林无法理解，也无法理解他们对贵族身份的执念。
对默里·格林来说，现在的日子已经很不错了，有吃有喝，想约几个美女，就约几个美女，自由自在，何必为了一棵树放弃整个森林。
既然上天再给他一次机会，他这一次一定要好好享受，不留遗憾，才不枉此生。
“贝丽尔，现在能陪我跳一支舞吗？”
默里·格林走到一个贵族少女面前，只见她眸若红杏，柳叶眉，樱桃红唇，肌肤胜雪，身材高挑，穿着一身贴身黑裙，上面点缀着点点银砂，在灯光的照耀下，如同黑夜中闪烁的星辰。
看到默里·格林伸到眼前的手，贝丽尔·佩特粲然一笑，瞟了一眼现在整个大厅最热闹的地方，然后打趣着说道。
“嘻嘻，默里，他们可都在竞争伊丽莎白殿下哦！你可是伯爵之子，为何不去。”
当一个女人在男人面前讨论另一个女人的时候，她大概率是吃醋了。
上辈子的默里·格林不是恋爱达人，只是一个九九六，但单身狗为了脱单，仔细拜读恋爱攻略，把这些技巧和手段融汇贯通之后，他成为了一个理论知识十分丰富的单身狗。
因为使用恋爱技巧的前提条件，是要有另一个人。
面对贝丽尔·佩特的问话，默里·格林忽然发现，自己以前拜读的恋爱技巧居然有了用武之地，于是他双目直视贝丽尔·佩特的眼睛，轻声的说道。
“我只是一个小小的伯爵之子，殿下如同天上的明月，可望不可即，我会尊敬她，但不会去爱她，因为我的心很小，只装得下一个人，那就是你，亲爱的贝丽尔。”
“噗呲，默里，你可真是个油嘴滑舌的坏蛋，不过我喜欢。”

贝丽尔·佩特掩面一笑，然后伸出洁白无瑕的手，轻轻搭在默里·格林的手掌上，回应了默里·格林的跳舞邀请。
默里·格林抬着贝丽尔·佩特的柔手走到跳舞的地方，转身面向贝丽尔·佩特，两人跟随着音乐一起舞动身躯。
content_en:
Everyone was attracted by the good show that was about to unfold, and no one saw Levi Ellis leaving alone, with the corners of his mouth raised, and a smile that showed success.
‘Let’s fight! The waves wash over the sand, but true gold is not afraid of fire. Now the stage for performance has been set. It depends on how wonderful your performance is. His Highness's future husband must be the best. ’
Thinking of this, Levi Ellis turned his eyes and looked at Murray Green, who was watching the show with squinted eyes. Murray Green, who was being stared at, was moved and turned to face Levi Ellis according to his feeling.
Finding Levi Ellis staring at him, Murray Green was a little confused, but he nodded with a smile and continued to watch the excitement.
‘This guy’s mental strength is definitely the strongest among our group. It’s only been less than a week and he’s already shown so much. What a genius! I don’t know if it can become a tactic, but if it can become a tactic, there is some hope. ’
Levi Ellis looked up at the conductor of the banquet band. He stretched out his index finger with his right hand, twisted it twice, and then pulled it up sharply. The originally gentle banquet music immediately became louder. The band conductor waved his hands vigorously, and the music became more and more exciting.
The exciting dance music reached his ears, and the two groups of people confronting each other became more and more excited. Hayden Margery looked at each other and walked forward at the lead. The foreign students opposite him were not to be outdone. The three of them stepped forward at the same time, all wanting to be the first.
"Hahaha, a group of stragglers also want to come to the North to meddle with our Royal Highness Elizabeth. They want to eat swan meat. They are delusional."
The faces of the foreign students who were ridiculed changed, but none of the three students who took the first step chose to retreat. Instead, they calmed down and continued to move forward.
"This is Hayden Margery, son of Marquis Margery. I would like to meet you all."
Hayden Margery raised a glass of wine with his right hand, straightened his face, and fired the first shot of the war.
"Maron Reed, grandson of Duke Reed of Southland."
"Bennet Lytton, son of Duke Lytton of the Royal Capital."
"Gustave Pierce, son of Duke Pierce of the Royal Capital."
No wonder these three people refused to give in to each other. It turned out that their status was almost the same. If anyone gave in or backed down, it would be a discredit to his noble surname.
"Hmph! These meritorious nobles are also here to join in the fun."
At this moment, an unknown voice came from somewhere. Upon hearing this, Bennett Litton and Gustav Pierce from the royal capital changed their expressions slightly, but they still clinked glasses with Hayden Margery and drank the wine in one gulp.
The entire kingdom of Lanyes can be divided into five parts, east, west, south, north, and center. The king sits in the central capital and is the backbone of the kingdom. The four great dukes of the east, west, south, and north guard the surrounding areas of the kingdom and are the famous border guards.
In the Northland, all nobles are canonized by the king and are vassals of the king. There is only a difference in noble rank. The difference between marquis and duke is only one level in noble rank, but in fact there is a huge gap.
The Grand Duke of the North can not only collect taxes from his own territory, but can even share the tax revenue of the entire North with the king. In time of war, the Grand Duke of the North automatically has the control of troops, conscription and war command in the entire North.
Therefore, except for the restrictions on the two rights of taxation and the right to declare war, the four major dukes in the east, west, north and south are not much different from the ruler of a principality.
The status of the four great dukes is second only to His Majesty the King, and they are the only four fiefdomed dukes in the entire Kingdom of Lanyes. In addition to the fiefdom nobles, there are also meritorious nobles in the Kingdom of Lanyes. These meritorious nobles have no territories, only annuities, and the noble titles cannot be hereditary.
In the eyes of the feudal nobles, these meritorious nobles are all high-level thugs raised by His Majesty the King. As long as they are strong enough, they can be named nobles.
Therefore, the feudal barons looked down upon the meritorious duke.
And now, the heirs of these meritorious nobles actually want to rely on Her Highness Elizabeth to become the husband of the Grand Duke of the North, get involved in the power of the Grand Duke of the North, and dominate them. This makes the surrounding noble heirs of the North extremely angry.
When Hayden Margery finished his drink and left, the next person held up his wine glass and tipped it to the top. The students from the North lined up to show the other side's color.
"Bored, drinking again, eh! The dance music has started, I have to go dance with the beautiful girl I made an appointment with."
People's sorrows are not connected to each other, so Murray Green cannot understand the anger of these Northland classmates, nor can he understand their obsession with aristocratic status.
For Murray Green, life is already very good now. He has food and drink, he can date as many beauties as he wants, and he is free. Why give up the entire forest for a tree.
Since God gives him another chance, he must enjoy it well this time and leave no regrets, so that his life will not be wasted.
"Beryl, can you dance with me now?"
Murray Green walked up to an aristocratic girl and saw that she had red apricot eyes, willow-leaf eyebrows, cherry-red lips, skin as good as snow, and a tall figure. She was wearing a close-fitting black dress dotted with dots of silver sand. Under the light, she looked like twinkling stars in the dark night.
Seeing Murray Green's hand stretched out in front of her eyes, Beryl Pate smiled brightly, glanced at the busiest place in the entire hall, and then said jokingly.
"Hehe, Murray, they are all competing for Her Royal Highness Elizabeth! You are the son of an earl, why don't you go."
When a woman discusses another woman in front of a man, she is most likely jealous.
In his previous life, Murray Green was not a love expert, just a 996. However, in order to get out of singles, he carefully read the love guide and integrated these techniques and methods, and he became a single with rich theoretical knowledge.
Because the prerequisite for using love skills is to have another person.
Facing Beryl Pate's questions, Murray Green suddenly found that the love skills he had studied before were actually useful, so he looked directly into Beryl Pate's eyes and spoke softly.
"I am just the son of a little earl. Your Highness is like the bright moon in the sky, just out of reach. I will respect her, but I will not love her, because my heart is small and can only accommodate one person, and that is you, dear Beryl."
"Pfft, Murray, you're such a glib bad guy, but I like it."
Beryl Pate smiled, then stretched out her flawless hand, gently placed it on Murray Green's palm, and responded to Murray Green's invitation to dance.
Murray Green carried Beryl Pate's soft hands to the dancing place, turned to face Beryl Pate, and the two of them danced to the music.
